disposition_reason: Supports a measured range of gallium in drinking groundwater from one large national survey. Does not support any health benchmark for gallium, because the authors found none.
disposition_locator: Results, metals section; Health Risk Assessment

study.method: Groundwater samples were analyzed for metals by ICP-MS alongside GC-MS and LC-QTOF/MS screening for organic compounds. Risks were estimated with Monte Carlo simulation using database or model-derived toxicity values.

regulatory_or_exposure: Groundwater gallium median to maximum 8.5 to 89 µg/L, detection frequency above 90%, n = 166 samples
No RfD available for gallium; excluded from noncarcinogenic risk assessment
